description: This source file defines CLI argument configuration functions for NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) settings, including epoch time, TA info, ephemeris info, polarization, and other NTN-specific parameters. It also includes conditional compilation for advanced NTN configuration.

methods.name: configure_cli11_epoch_time
methods.description: Configures CLI options for epoch time parameters, including SFN and subframe number.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ta_info
methods.description: Configures CLI options for TA (Timing Advance) information, including common TA, drift, and offset.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ephemeris_info_ecef
methods.description: Configures CLI options for satellite ephemeris in ECEF coordinates.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ephemeris_info_orbital
methods.description: Configures CLI options for satellite ephemeris in orbital coordinates.

methods.name: configure_cli11_ntn_polarization
methods.description: Configures CLI options for satellite polarization parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_ntn_config_args
methods.description: Configures NTN assistance information arguments, including epoch time, TA info, polarization, and ephemeris info.

methods.name: configure_cli11_advanced_ntn_args
methods.description: Configures advanced NTN parameters if the macro OCUDU_HAS_ENTERPRISE_NTN is defined.

methods.name: ocudu::configure_cli11_cell_ntn_args
methods.description: Configures cell-specific NTN parameters, optionally using existing configuration.
